issues.description: In the template repository the fixed-point word size macro FIX_LEN differs between the example program and the tests. The example program headers (and example code) use FIX_LEN = 8 (64-bit fix_t), while the tests in the template set FIX_LEN = 4 (32-bit fix_t). This is an inner-repository structural inconsistency: different translation units will compile with different assumptions about the underlying fix_t size and representation, causing confusing behavior, mismatched expected values in tests, and likely compile / runtime errors or incorrect test results for students. The solution repository consistently uses FIX_LEN = 8, indicating the intended setup is 8-byte fixed-point numbers.
issues.suggested_fix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the repository so all translation units use the same fixed-point width. Concretely, update the template tests header (tests/src/math_fix.h) to define FIX_LEN = 8 (matching example_program and the solution), or centralize FIX_LEN into a single project-level header and #include it everywhere. Ensure tests, example program and headers all compile with the same FIX_LEN and typedefs for fix_t/fixu_t.
